content.text:
Three classes in `guava/src` directly declare `implements Cache<K, V>`:

- `com.google.common.cache.AbstractCache` (guava/src/com/google/common/cache/AbstractCache.java:42)
- `com.google.common.cache.ForwardingCache` (guava/src/com/google/common/cache/ForwardingCache.java:38)
- `com.google.common.cache.LocalCache.LocalManualCache` (guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java:4830)

ANSWER: AbstractCache, ForwardingCache, and LocalCache.LocalManualCache (a static nested class in LocalCache.java) are the classes in guava/src that directly declare `implements Cache<K, V>`.
